text.headline: Timeline of Iraq
text.text: Major events in the history of Iraq.

events.headline: Sumerian Civilization Emerges
events.text: The Sumerians established one of the world's first civilizations in southern Mesopotamia, developing writing, urban centers, and complex societies.

events.headline: Akkadian Empire Founded
events.text: Sargon of Akkad united the Sumerian city-states and established the Akkadian Empire, one of the first empires in history.

events.headline: Hammurabi's Code
events.text: King Hammurabi of Babylon codified laws that became one of the earliest and most complete written legal codes.

events.headline: Fall of the Assyrian Empire
events.text: The Assyrian Empire, known for its military prowess and architectural achievements, fell to a coalition of Medes, Babylonians, and Scythians.

events.headline: Cyrus the Great Conquers Babylon
events.text: Cyrus the Great of Persia conquered Babylon, marking the beginning of Persian rule over Mesopotamia.

events.headline: Alexander the Great Conquers Persia
events.text: Alexander the Great defeated Darius III of Persia and took control of Babylon, spreading Greek culture throughout the region.

events.headline: Islamic Conquest of Iraq
events.text: Muslim forces defeated the Sassanian Empire at the Battle of Qadisiyyah, leading to the spread of Islam in Iraq.

events.headline: Abbasid Caliphate Established
events.text: The Abbasid Caliphate was established, with Baghdad becoming a major center of culture, science, and trade.

events.headline: Sack of Baghdad
events.text: The Mongol Empire, led by Hulagu Khan, sacked Baghdad, marking the end of the Islamic Golden Age in the city.

events.headline: Ottoman Conquest of Iraq
events.text: The Ottoman Empire conquered Iraq, incorporating it into its vast territories and ruling for several centuries.

events.headline: World War I Begins
events.text: Iraq, then part of the Ottoman Empire, became a battleground during World War I as British forces sought to control the region.

events.headline: Iraqi Revolt Against British Rule
events.text: The Iraqi revolt against British rule began, leading to a prolonged struggle for independence.

events.headline: Iraq Gains Independence
events.text: Iraq was granted independence from British mandate, becoming a sovereign state.

events.headline: Iraqi Revolution
events.text: A coup led by the Free Officers Movement overthrew the monarchy, establishing a republic.

events.headline: Ba'ath Party Takes Power
events.text: The Ba'ath Party, led by Saddam Hussein, seized control of Iraq, beginning a period of authoritarian rule.

events.headline: Iran-Iraq War Begins
events.text: The Iran-Iraq War began, lasting eight years and resulting in significant casualties and economic damage.

events.headline: Invasion of Kuwait
events.text: Iraq invaded Kuwait, leading to international condemnation and the eventual Gulf War.

events.headline: U.S.-Led Invasion of Iraq
events.text: A coalition led by the United States invaded Iraq, resulting in the toppling of Saddam Hussein's regime.

events.headline: First Democratic Elections
events.text: Iraq held its first democratic elections since the fall of Saddam Hussein, marking a significant step towards democratic governance.

events.headline: U.S. Troops Withdraw
events.text: The last U.S. combat troops withdrew from Iraq, ending nearly nine years of military presence.

events.headline: Rise of ISIS
events.text: The Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) captured Mosul, declaring a caliphate and leading to widespread violence and instability.

events.headline: Defeat of ISIS
events.text: Iraqi forces declared victory over ISIS, reclaiming territory and restoring some stability to the region.

events.headline: Protests Against Corruption
events.text: Nationwide protests erupted in Iraq against government corruption, unemployment, and lack of basic services.

events.headline: Parliamentary Elections
events.text: Iraq held parliamentary elections, aimed at addressing the demands of the protest movement and reforming the political system.

events.headline: Ongoing Political Challenges
events.text: Iraq continues to face political instability, economic challenges, and security threats, as it navigates its post-ISIS recovery.
